decisions.quote: We conduct a computational replication of the main results of the paper using the same procedures and original data. Our results confirm the sign, magnitude and statistical significance of the author’s reported estimates across each of their five main findings.
decisions.reason: The paper conducts only a computational reproduction using the original study's procedures and econometric specifications; reconstructing the original outcome variable from the choice data using the original authors' formula and parameterizations is a step to verify computational reproducibility rather than an alternative specification or robustness check.
